name: The Mensetsukan
source:
Main character gets promoted to a leading information service resources manager position in the environment of total recession everywhere. He has full authority over the the hiring process and can choose the prettiest and cutest candidates from the piles of applications. He can't hold his affection and harasses one of candidates. Applicants are desperate to get a job and thus are easy to prey on.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
